items.title: 'Transfer van Steur naar Newcastle komt veel te vroeg'
items.summary: Ajax ontvangt een miljoenenbedrag voor Steur, maar is een overstap naar Newcastle United wel de juiste keuze voor de jonge middenvelder? Freek Jansen vindt van niet en legt uit waarom talenten volgens hem eerst moeten doorbreken in de Eredivisie voordat ze de stap naar de Premier League maken. Martijn Krabbendam begrijpt de keuze van de speler, maar wijst ook op de enorme concurrentie in Engeland.

items.title: Wolfsburg komt met Eriksen-update: middenvelder herstelt in Denemarken
items.summary: VfL Wolfsburg heeft donderdag een update gegeven over de medische situatie van Christian Eriksen. Vlak voor het WK schrok de voetbalwereld op toen de Deense spelmaker opnieuw last kreeg van hartfalen tijdens een wedstrijd. De Duitse club deelt mee dat de middenvelder in zijn thuisland zal herstellen.

items.title: Manchester United insist new stadium ‘not vanity project’ despite prospect of more debt
items.summary: Plan unveiled for ground 350 metres from Old Trafford Working cost of stadium previously stated as £2bn Manchester United have said their proposed new 100,000-capacity stadium may lead to further debt being loaded on the club but insisted it will be “a sanity, not vanity project”. Plans for United’s new home were unveiled on Thursday and showed it would be built 350 metres north-west of the current Old Trafford. The club are about £1.3bn in debt and in March 2025 Omar Berrada, United’s chief executive, said £2bn was the working cost of the stadium. Continue reading...

items.title: Newcastle agree £51.5m Johan Manzambi deal and insist Bruno Guimarães not for sale
items.summary: Switzerland international poised to sign from Freiburg Guimarães wants to leave and is target for Arsenal Newcastle have agreed a £51.5m deal with Freiburg that should see the versatile Switzerland midfielder Johan Manzambi swap the Bundesliga for the Premier League. The 20-year-old, who has shone during this summer’s World Cup, is expected to sign a long-term contract at St James’ Park but the transfer will not be finalised while Switzerland remain in the World Cup. Manzambi, who has been widely coveted this summer, is struggling with a minor knee injury and Murat Yakin, Switzerland’s head coach, is unsure as to whether he will recover in time for the quarter-final against Argentina on Sunday. Continue reading...

items.title: ‘Is he a nice guy? No. He’s a good guy’: how Harry Kane became an England great
items.summary: Figures who worked with striker in his formative years recall a self-belief – even when his talent did not stand out There is another version of reality in which Harry Kane is not England’s greatest goalscorer but a goalkeeper. On his first day at Ridgeway Rovers, his first club, the coach Dave Bricknell asked whether anyone fancied going in goal. A six-year-old Kane threw up his hand – and he was pretty good. “I thought I’d found a goalkeeper,” Bricknell says. “At that age, you don’t get many kids that don’t mind standing in front of a ball.” Continue reading...
